# Draft:Edward Murphy Kelahan

----
Born on January 9, 1968, in Amityville, Long Island, New York, he is the son of Thomas and Kathleen Kelahan. He has three brothers—Benjamin, Paul, and Joseph Kelahan—and one sister, Clare Kelahan (Mutone). He is a proud father of three daughters: Cristina, Brianne, and Kaley Kelahan.
He is an active member of the Screen Actors Guild, the American Federation of Television and Radio Artists, and the Writers Guild of America.
His acting training includes studying at Maria Greco’s Dove Tails Actors Resources, Scene Study & Commercial Class in Manhattan, Ted Bardy Studio (Meisner Technique), CNC Studios with Jagger Kaye (Commercial Class/Scene Study), Clayton Fletcher’s Stand Up Comedy in Manhattan, and Drivers East Stunt Driving School for vehicle stunts and precision driving.
He co-hosted the TV show “ADTV (Attention Deficit Television)” alongside Rose Iebba and co-wrote and co-created “Cuffs & Shield” with Mauricio Ovalle. His production credits include “The Last Minutes,” “Cuffs & Shield,” “Despair,” and “The Cover Up,” which he also wrote and directed.
Television appearances include:
* Co-star role as a DC Officer in NBC’s “The Blacklist” (Episode: Fredrick Barnes) opposite Megan Boone and Diego Klattenhoff
* Co-star role as a Paramedic in NBC’s “Unforgettable” (Episode: Maps & Legends) opposite Poppy Montgomery
* Co-star role as Phillip Carroll in Showtime’s “Billions” (Episode: Currency) opposite David Costabile, directed by Steph Green
* Co-star role as Juror #7 in NBC’s “Bull” (Episode: Justice for Cable) opposite Michael Weatherly and Freddy Rodriguez
* Co-star role as Patrolman #1 in HBO’s “The Deuce” (Episode: We’re All Beasts) opposite Maggie Gyllenhaal
* Guest anchor appearance on CNN’s “Anderson Cooper 360” for the 30th Anniversary Space Shuttle Challenger Disaster, portraying lead anchor Tom Mintier
* Recurring role as Desk Officer in NTD’s “A Good Cop” opposite Ignacyo Matynia and Cliff Lobrutto, directed by David Chai
Film credits include:
* Supporting role and stunts as an undercover detective in “Revenge of the Green Dragons” (Dir. Andrew Loo)
* Supporting and stunt driver role as NYPD in “Tracers” (Dir. Daniel Benmayor)
* Supporting role as Ron, the delivery driver, in “Furlough” opposite Melissa Leo and Tessa Thompson (Dir. Laurie Collyer)
* Supporting role as Officer Callahan in “To Live and Die in BedStuy” opposite Jacinto Taras Riddick (Dir. Joseph C Grant Jr.)
* Supporting role as Sol in “Honor Among Thieves” opposite Azia Toussaint (Dir. Joseph C Grant Jr.)
* Supporting role as ICE Agent #1 in “Sanctuary” opposite Jon Michael Hill (Dir. Devin Hampton)
Comedy television appearances:
* Recurring role as Police Officer in Comedy Central’s “Mini Mocks” (Episodes: “Sand Sculptor,”)
* Co-star roles in Comedy Central Originals as Father in “Yule Hide,” and Arresting Police Officer in “The Alec Baldwin Special”
Commercial work includes numerous spec, local, regional, and national ads for major brands such as Deer Park Water, Cognizant, Verizon, Lays Potato Chips, Footlocker, Audi, Chevy, Toyota, Doritos, and many more. Roles have ranged from Fireman and Father to Patrolman, Homeowner, and Security Officer.
Podcast appearances include the hit series “Limetown” (Season One, Episode 2: “Winona”), where he played the role of Manic Man.
